friendsDesign.findDescription: Find someone by nickname or their full friend code.
friendsDesign.noOnlineHint: Friends appear here when they come online. Your invitations are still available under Requests.
friendsDesign.emptyHint: Find your first friend by nickname or share your code from the panel beside this list.

release3.title: Luxmc 3.0 — Your updated launcher
release3.summary: A refreshed interface, NameMC appearance tools, corrected catalogs and official Minecraft news.
release3.appearance: Larger cards, imported wallpapers and improved light theme contrast
release3.skins: NameMC catalog, a cape per skin and application with Microsoft synchronization
release3.content: Content installation in compatible instances and cached game preparation
release3.social: Fixes for rooms, invite codes and friend requests
release3.updates: Automatic news, system language detection and revised Windows installer

multiplayer.autoLan: Create the room now. When you open a Minecraft world to LAN, Luxmc detects its port automatically and follows world changes.
multiplayer.createAnytime: Your room can stay open before Minecraft starts. Invite your friends and open a world to LAN when you are ready to play.
multiplayer.worldReady: LAN world detected. Ready to connect.
multiplayer.waitingWorld: Room connected. Waiting for the host to open a world to LAN.
multiplayer.sameVersions: Use the same Minecraft version and compatible matching mods on both computers.

profileCard.title: Your profile
profileCard.synced: Profile connected to the Luxmc portal.
profileCard.microsoftSkins: After applying and syncing, your Microsoft skin is saved to your official profile and is visible to other players. Local capes require Luxmc support.
profileCard.luxmcSkins: Luxmc account: applying publishes your skin and cape for other clients with Luxmc Custom Skin support. Match the game version and mods to play together. A resource pack alone does not provide this support.
profileCard.nicknameRule: Use 3 to 16 letters, numbers or underscores.
profileCard.offlineSkins: Local account: customization stays on this computer. Sign in with a Luxmc account to share your skin and cape with compatible clients, or with Microsoft to use your official skin.
